(623)༄༅/ /myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor chog nyer bsdus bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal la

tei:div.tei:p: myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor chog nyer bsdus bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal lo/ nang mchod gtor ma byin rlabs yi dam ltar bya/ rang gi mdun du pad nyi la hūm̐ las ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa sku mdog mthing nag dang po gnyis gri thod/ bar ma gnyis mi mgo'i phreng ba dang rtse gsum/ tha ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang zhags pa/ stag lpags dang mgo phreng rus pa dang sbrul dang phyag zhabs la dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pas tshogs kyi bdag po mnan pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs sma ra smin ma dbu skra gyen du rdzes pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sindhu ra'i thig le dpral bar byug pa/ tsandan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i g.yon du bhyo las dpal ldan lha mo nag mo dre'u la zhon pa khram shing nad rkyal thogs pa/ mdun du gnod sbyin kṣe tra pā la smug nag gri thod 'dzin pa/ dom nag smyon pa la zhon pa/ g.yas su dzi na mi tra dmar nag cang te'u dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu ṭā ki rā dza nag po spu gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon du bdud mgon trakshad ru mtshon dang thod snying 'dzin pa/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dang swag lh+wam gsol ba/ de'i phyi rol du dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho bsil ba'i tshal tsandan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas shing g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa/ bka' sdod zhing skyong pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la sa pā ri wā ra kṣiṃ nyer gcig /badzra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣiṃ kṣe tra bi ghnān bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes mang du bzla'o// sngags de ka'i mthar/ i daṃ ba li ta kha kha khā (624)hi khā hi/ btags pa lan gsum/ de bzhin tu/ /bhyo ma mo nag mo be tā li siṅga ku lu ku lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kṣe tra pā la bi ghān hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzi na mi tra wa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ḍā ki rā dza sa ma ya bhyo du dzaḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ du yo ga dzaḥm hā kā la trakshad hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes 'khor re re la i daṃ sogs btags pa gsum gsum/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ shā sa ni u pa hā ri ṇī e ṣo a pashtsi ma kā lo3yaṃ i daṃ ratna tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇi ya di pra ti dzña sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣṭaṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ sogs lan gsum gyis dam can spyi la 'bul/ arghaṃ sogs mchod/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ /hūm̐/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ka mnan// nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can// phyag drug sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan// g.yas pas gri gug bar bas phreng ba 'dzin// tha mas ḍā ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol// g.yon pas thod pa dang ni mdung rtse gsum// de bzhin zhags pas bzung nas 'ching bar byed// drag po'i zhal nas mche ba rnam par gtsigs// spyan gsum drag po'i dbu skra gyen du 'bar// dpral bar sindhū ra yis legs par byugs// spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal po'i rgyas btab brtan// khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can// rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// shing las byon nas gtor ma len par mdzod// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ bla mgon dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs dang grib sel la sogs pa rjes 'di ltar byas kyang rung*/

yig brgya bzod gsol smon lam dang bkra shis brjod/ phyag drug ye shes kyi mgon po'i gtor chog bsdus pa khyer bde ba 'di ni/ gangs kar rdo rje gdan gyi sku gnyer ba nyi ma rnam rgyal gyis bskul ngor/ tā ra nā thas pho brang gangs dkar du sbyar ba'o/// /maṅga laṃ//
